name: nnInteractive
plain: nnInteractive (DKFZ): a promptable 3D segmenter: click a point, draw a box or a scribble on any structure in a CT, MRI, PET or microscopy volume and it returns that structure's 3D mask; further prompts (positive or negative) refine it. Non-commercial weights (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0).
summary: nnInteractive (Isensee et al. 2025): DKFZ's promptable 3D segmentation for CT, MRI, PET and 3D microscopy. Point, box (2D or 3D) and scribble prompts, positive or negative, refine one object mask in a session; a ResEnc-L U-Net on 192³ patches with AutoZoom (zooms out up to 4x while the mask grows past the patch, then refines the changed region at full resolution). Lasso prompts and initial masks are not ported.
task_io: Input: a CT volume `[D, H, W]` in Hounsfield units and its voxel spacing in mm (`volume.read_nifti` reads both from a NIfTI file). Output: a class index per voxel `[D, H, W]` on the input grid (0 = background). Encoder models (nnFoundation) take a CT or MRI volume and give its encoder feature maps.

variants.name: nninteractive

licence.training_note: 120+ volumetric 3D datasets (CT, MRI, PET, 3D microscopy; readme) with simulated prompts.

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

quality.title: TotalSegmentator test subset (8 CT cases x 12 prompts), mean Dice vs the ground-truth mask
quality.protocol: A small subset of real CT cases of the TotalSegmentator dataset (not the full test split), each run at its card's spacing (1.5 or 3 mm) in the same pipeline; mean over the cases of the Dice (0 to 1) averaged over the classes present, against the ground-truth segmentations (vertebrae_L6 of the subset has no counterpart and is skipped). Original = TotalSegmentator 2.18.0, default fp16 autocast. nnInteractive: per case 12 simulated prompts (point, box, scribble, point + box on 3 organs), one interaction each; Dice of the predicted mask against the ground-truth organ mask, mean over the runs; agreement = Dice of the mask against the original's mask. Original = the authors' code, fp16 autocast.

original16.note: 8 TotalSegmentator cases x 12 prompts (point, box, scribble, point+box x 3 classes), Dice vs the ground-truth mask; agree = Dice vs the original's mask; original = fp16 autocast

portable.note: 8 TotalSegmentator cases x 12 prompts (point, box, scribble, point+box x 3 classes), Dice vs the ground-truth mask; agree = Dice vs the original's mask; original = fp16 autocast

kernels.note: 8 TotalSegmentator cases x 12 prompts (point, box, scribble, point+box x 3 classes), Dice vs the ground-truth mask; agree = Dice vs the original's mask; original = fp16 autocast

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.003 and p99 <= 0.5 (absolute error of the output `mask`).
